metadata.prompt: Coastal park @图片1, dark stormy sky, purple cracks covering the ground all the way to the park exit, MCU color grading reference @图片2. Yaoyao in hero armor @图片3, sparks on his armor, slowly stands up again with resolve. The octopus monster @图片4 raises all eight tentacles from different directions. Purple energy floods and converges toward the glowing crack on the monster's chest. Yaoyao watches and waits — left eye flickers, chest crack glows, tentacles tighten. He counts the rhythm. Then he stands firm and says: 停。Absolute silence falls. An orange stasis field wraps around the purple core on the monster's chest. All eight tentacles freeze simultaneously mid-air. Purple cracks on the ground stop spreading. Goggle first gauge dims. Yaoyao carefully steps over a frozen tentacle lying on the ground — only his breathing and small boot steps audible. Second gauge dims. He runs toward the monster. He reaches it — but he is too short, cannot reach the chest crack. He looks up, thinks for one beat. Third gauge begins flashing urgently. Yaoyao steps onto a frozen tentacle, climbs up two small steps, then leaps with both hands outstretched — pressing both palms firmly onto the glowing chest crack. Third gauge goes dark. Orange energy lines burst from his palms and spread across the monster's entire body. All sound rushes back at once. The purple core is pushed out of the sculpture body, compressed into a small dark purple shard that drops to the ground. Slow motion on the leap, the palm press, and the core ejection. Total 15 seconds. No BGM
